title: Garage Sale
one_paragraph_synopsis: Dunder Mifflin holds its first garage sale to raise money for a party fund, featuring various humorous and competitive interactions among the staff, including Dwight's trading antics and disputes over game rules. Meanwhile, Michael prepares and ultimately proposes to Holly in the office, leading to her acceptance and their decision to move to Colorado together.

main_threads.thread: The garage sale event and related staff interactions, including item trading, disputes over garage door status, and board game conflicts.
